Package de.learnlib.filter.statistic.sul

Class CounterSUL<I,O>

java.lang.Object
de.learnlib.filter.statistic.sul.CounterSUL<I,O>
Type Parameters:

O - output symbol type
All Implemented Interfaces:

Direct Known Subclasses:

public class CounterSUL<I,O> extends Object implements SUL<I,O>
Wrapper for a SUL that gathers various statistics on queries sent to this SUL.

    • KEY_QUERY

      public static final StatisticsKey KEY_QUERY
      The StatisticsKey this class uses for counting the number of posts executed on the SUL. This corresponds to the number of queries answered by the SUL.

    • KEY_SYMBOL

      public static final StatisticsKey KEY_SYMBOL
      The StatisticsKey this class uses for counting the number of steps executed on the SUL. This corresponds to the number of symbols of each query.

    • CounterSUL

      public CounterSUL(SUL<I,O> delegate, @Nullable String id)
      Constructs a new counter SUL that writes statistical data to a StatisticsService. The provided id is used to refine the supported StatisticsKeys and allows for using multiple instances of this class for different purposes.
      Parameters:
      delegate - the SUL to delegate calls to
      id - the id used for specializing the statistics keys

    • fork

      public SUL<I,O> fork()
      Description copied from interface: SUL
      Forks this SUL, if possible. The fork of a SUL is a copy which behaves exactly the same as this SUL. This method should always return a reset SUL, regardless of whether this call is made between a call to SUL.pre() and SUL.post().

      If SUL.canFork() returns true, this method must return a non-null object, which should behave exactly like this SUL (in particular, it must be forkable as well). Otherwise, a UnsupportedOperationException must be thrown.

      Implementation note: if resetting a SUL changes the internal state of this object in a non-trivial way (e.g., incrementing a counter to ensure independent sessions), care must be taken that forks of this SUL manipulate the same internal state.

      Specified by:
      fork in interface SUL<I,O>
      Returns:
      a fork of this SUL.
